verdict.rationale: Customer.io explicitly claims broad API/CLI/MCP parity — "you can do just about anything you can do in Customer.io via your AI tool of choice" (docs-27) and "Your AI can do anything you'd do by clicking or typing" (docs-1) — backed by a documented Pipelines/Track/App API set, CLI, and MCP server (docs-26, probe-2, probe-3). However, some workflows still require UI setup first (e.g. "you'll set up a broadcast in our UI and then trigger it with a single call" docs-4, and drafting emails "in Design Studio" docs-16), showing partial rather than total UI/API parity. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that all UI-only features (e.g. visual automation building, Design Studio AI styling) are fully API-accessible, and no documented exceptions.
